state_of_play.description: Two or three plain sentences: where this paradigm stands now, as measured results show it, not as press releases claim it.

measured_results.description: Results with numbers, since the date in the question: a benchmark, an energy figure, a demonstrated scale. Not funding rounds or announcements.

active_organisations.description: Labs, companies and groups doing the work, with what each is known for.

open_access.description: Things an outsider can use today: open simulators, software libraries, datasets, dev kits, cloud or remote access to hardware, with any price.

cheap_experiments.description: Experiments a one-person lab could run on a laptop or a free CPU runner in under ten minutes, that would test a live question about this paradigm.

open_questions.description: The questions the field itself says are unresolved.
